part.text: Standing up has failed twice, and the tool says getting up after a fall is unreliable in this simulator. I'll put the robot in rest mode.

state.title: naoqi_rest

part.text:
The robot didn't reach the red wall. It fell on its back partway through the corridor, couldn't get back up, and is now resting with its motors off.

**What happened:**
1. It walked 3 m straight ahead to the first corner, turned left, and went another 3 m.
2. The next turn to the right was blocked by a jog in the corridor. After a few small sidesteps and turns it got past and walked about 1.3 m, to the following corner.
3. It turned left and walked 3 m. Looking left during this stretch, I saw a bit of red far away around a corner, so the end of the corridor was probably close.
4. At the next corner, a turn to the right ran into the wall's collision protection. The robot fell on its back during this move.
5. I tried to stand it up twice and both attempts timed out. The tool's own message says getting up after a fall rarely works in this simulator and recommends resting and asking a person to reset the robot. So I put it in rest mode.

**What's needed:** someone has to reset or stand the robot up by hand. Then I can finish the last stretch to the red wall. The corners in this corridor are offset, so I'll step away from the wall before turning to avoid another fall.
